entities.summary: Robert Kovařík, known professionally as Robert Van Damme, is a Czech-French gay pornographic film actor, director, and producer, and former ice hockey player. After making his pornography debut in 2003, he became an exclusive model with Hot House Entertainment in 2005 and founded his own gay pornography studio, RVD Films, in 2009. In 2014, Kovařík was sentenced to nine years in prison by a Czech court for a series of armed robberies committed between 1999 and 2000.
